name: STA261H1 — Socratic Discovery (Sufficiency and Rao-Blackwell)
description: T(X) is SUFFICIENT for θ if distribution of X given T doesn't depend on θ. T captures ALL info about θ. Fisher-Neyman: T sufficient ⟺ f(x|θ)=g(T(x),θ)

steps.template_en: T(X) is SUFFICIENT for θ if distribution of X given T doesn't depend on θ. T captures ALL info about θ. Fisher-Neyman: T sufficient ⟺ f(x|θ)=g(T(x),θ)·h(x). h(x) free of θ.
steps.template_zh: T(X)对θ充分若给定T时的条件分布不依赖θ。T捕获所有θ信息。Fisher-Neyman因子分解。

steps.template_en: X₁,...,Xₙ~Bernoulli(p): f(x|p)=p^{Σxᵢ}(1-p)^{n-Σxᵢ}. T=Σxᵢ: g(T,p)=p^T(1-p)^{n-T}. T sufficient. Sample median? NOT sufficient — lose info.
steps.template_zh: Bernoulli(p): T=Σxᵢ充分。样本中位数？不充分——丢失信息。

steps.template_en: Rao-Blackwell: If θ̂ unbiased and T sufficient, then θ̂*=E[θ̂|T] is: (1) VALID (function of T). (2) UNBIASED. (3) Var(θ̂*)≤Var(θ̂). Equality iff θ̂ already function of T.
steps.template_zh: Rao-Blackwell: 若θ̂无偏T充分，则θ̂*=E[θ̂|T]：(1)有效。(2)无偏。(3)方差≤Var(θ̂)。

steps.template_en: Example: X₁,...,Xₙ~Poisson(λ). Unbiased for e^{-λ}: δ₀=I(X₁=0). T=ΣXᵢ sufficient. δ*=E[δ₀|T=t]=((n-1)/n)^t.
(1) Show X̄ sufficient for μ in N(μ,σ²) with known σ². (2) For X~Unif(0,θ), find sufficient statistic. (3) For Bernoulli(p), improve δ=I(X₁=1,X₂=0) via Rao-Blackwell. (4) UMVUE for p is X̄.
steps.template_zh: (1)N(μ,σ²)中X̄对μ充分。(2)Unif(0,θ)找充分统计量。(3)用Rao-Blackwell改进估计。(4)p的UMVUE是X̄。

steps.template_en: Rao-Blackwell: OPTIMAL estimators by (1) any unbiased estimator → (2) condition on sufficient T. Never WORSE. Reduces search for UMVUE to functions of sufficient stats. Lehmann-Scheffé: if T COMPLETE sufficient → UNIQUE UMVUE.
steps.template_zh: Rao-Blackwell：通过(1)任意无偏估计→(2)在充分T上取条件找到最优估计。从不更差。将UMVUE搜索简化为充分统计量的函数。
